patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in crm, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Frame: Same category, different company size — Both sit in crm, but documented company-size audiences diverge.. Choose Mailchimp only if your buying job matches “Email marketing with CRM features; freemium entry (secondary category: marketing).” rather than SAP Customer Experience's shape. Choose SAP Customer Experience only if your buying job matches “SAP Customer Experience / Sales Cloud; custom enterprise quote only.” rather than Mailchimp's shape. Workflow advantage: Mailchimp leans contact-management; SAP Customer Experience leans pipeline-management, sales-automation. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in crm, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Mailchimp is Email marketing with CRM features; freemium entry (secondary category: marketing).; SAP Customer Experience is SAP Customer Experience / Sales Cloud; custom enterprise quote only..
- Company-size focus: Mailchimp (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs SAP Customer Experience (enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Mailchimp-leaning contact-management vs SAP Customer Experience-leaning pipeline-management, sales-automation, account-management.
- Researched limits: Mailchimp — Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform; SAP Customer Experience — Custom quote only.

Limitations — Mailchimp: Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform; Paid pricing is contact-based and changes — verify live; SAP Customer Experience: Custom quote only; High implementation overhead.

Poor-fit cases: Mailchimp is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform · SAP Customer Experience is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Custom quote only · Avoid Mailchimp if you actually need SAP Customer Experience's motion (SAP Customer Experience / Sales Cloud; custom enterprise quote only.)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
